enchantments.tooltip: +10 Enhancement Bonus: +10 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.

Fire Shield (Cold): When you are successfully attacked, there is a 10% chance that a Fire Shield (Cold) will be cast on you. If this effect activates while you have an active Fire Shield (Hot) from another item source, they will nullify each-other.
Constitution +11: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +11 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.
Lesser Displacement: Equipping this item causes light to distort around you. Attacks from enemies have a 25% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Spell Resistance +33: +33 Enhancement bonus to Spell Resistance.
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
